delete.summary: Deletes an artist, their photo and their applications, and takes them out of their collectives and their sets

get.summary: An artist's photo, as it was sent, or one of its sizes

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width to serve it at, in pixels: 320 or 1280, or narrower when it is, as WebP. Without it, it is served as it was sent

200.description: The photo, with the type it was checked to have, or, with `width`, its size at that width, as WebP. Browsers are told not to guess another type (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`), and that they can keep it, only in the browser that asked for it, never in a shared cache, but have to check with the server before showing it again (`Cache-Control: private, no-cache`). The photo and each of its sizes have an `ETag` of their own, which changes whenever the photo does, or, for a size, how sizes are made

304.description: The request's `If-None-Match` has the `ETag` of what it asks for, so the browser already has it: it isn't sent again

put.summary: Gives an artist a photo, or replaces their photo, which is deleted, and changes nothing else

photo.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP image of up to 10 MB, whose type is told from its contents, that can be read, of at most 100 million pixels. An empty file is no photo

delete.summary: Removes an artist's photo, which is deleted, and changes nothing else

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The photo's name, as the URL of its size gives it

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size's name, as its URL gives it, e.g. `w320.v2.webp`

200.description: That size of the photo, as WebP. Browsers are told not to guess another type (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`), and that anyone, shared caches included, can keep it for good, without checking with the server again (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`): its URL changes whenever what it serves does

start.description: A date and time, which can be left without seconds, in Québec time, with the offset from UTC in effect then, from 2000 to 2999 in UTC. Null, or blank, for none

durationMinutes.description: Minutes that actually pass, whatever the clocks say. A session ends by the start of the year 3000, in UTC

takeover.description: The id of the collective whose takeover the session is: a takeover has one, and the other types none. Null, or blank, for none

application.description: The id of the application the session comes from: a collective's, whose takeover the session is. Null, or blank, for none

name.description: Its own name, which replaces the one its type gives it, kept as sent, its case included: send back the session's `name`, not its `title`. A session of type other has one. Each run of spaces, tabs or line breaks becomes a single space, and it is trimmed, then up to 100 characters. Empty for none

raEvent.description: The event's id on RA, or a link to it. Null, or blank, for none

description.description: Its own description, as plain text, which replaces the one its type gives it: send back the session's `description`, not its `effectiveDescription`. Each \r\n or \r becomes \n, and it is trimmed, then up to 5000 characters. Empty for none

delete.summary: Deletes a session, its flyer and its sets, which leave the radio's rotation, but not their performers

get.summary: A session's flyer, as it was sent, or one of its sizes

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width to serve it at, in pixels: 320 or 1280, or narrower when it is, as WebP. Without it, it is served as it was sent

200.description: The flyer, with the type it was checked to have, or, with `width`, its size at that width, as WebP. Browsers are told not to guess another type (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`), and that they can keep it, only in the browser that asked for it, never in a shared cache, but have to check with the server before showing it again (`Cache-Control: private, no-cache`). The flyer and each of its sizes have an `ETag` of their own, which changes whenever the flyer does, or, for a size, how sizes are made

304.description: The request's `If-None-Match` has the `ETag` of what it asks for, so the browser already has it: it isn't sent again

put.summary: Gives a session a flyer, or replaces its flyer, which is deleted, and changes nothing else

flyer.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP image of up to 10 MB, whose type is told from its contents, that can be read, of at most 100 million pixels. An empty file is no flyer

delete.summary: Removes a session's flyer, which is deleted, and changes nothing else

put.summary: Marks a session as planned, done or cancelled: cancelling it cancels its sets, and marking it done marks its planned sets done

Announces a session, which makes it public, as an event, with its sets, and makes public the profiles and photos of its sets' performers, and of the collective whose takeover it is, with its members, or un-announces it

post.summary: Adds a set to a session, as planned, after its other sets, and returns the session, which this can make planned again

patch.summary: Changes a set, only the fields it's given, but not its session, its place among the session's sets, or its status, and returns its session

performers.description: Artists, in order, at least one, once those that are there twice, whatever the case of their ids, are dropped

durationMinutes.description: Null while it isn't known, which counts for nothing: see "Sets' order" in the rules

performanceTypes.description: In any order, even more than once: saved in the order of the list, without duplicates

otherPerformanceType.description: Each run of spaces, tabs or line breaks becomes a single space, and it is trimmed, then up to 60 characters. Empty for none

genres.description: Most important first. Those that are there twice are dropped, keeping the first

soundcloudTrack.description: A link to the track on soundcloud.com, or its private link. Null, or blank, for none

youtubeVideo.description: A link to the video on YouTube, or its id. Null, or blank, for none

application.description: The id of the application the set comes from: an artist's, who is one of its performers. Null, or blank, for none

delete.summary: Deletes a set, which leaves the radio's rotation, but not its performers, and returns its session, which this can make done

put.summary: Marks a set as planned, done or cancelled, and returns its session, which this can make done, or planned again
Moves a set to another place among its session's sets, the others keeping their order, and returns its session
Moves a set to another session, after its sets, without changing its status, and returns that session, and the one it was in, whose statuses this can change

post.summary: A token for publishing a session's event on Resident Advisor with the bookmarklet, which lasts an hour

get.summary: The event that the bookmarklet creates on Resident Advisor for the session of the token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
The flyer of the session of the token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, as a JPEG within RA's limits, which the bookmarklet uploads to Resident Advisor

200.description: The session's flyer, as a JPEG of at most 2000 × 2000 pixels and 3,000,000 bytes. Browsers are told not to guess another type (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`)

put.summary: Saves the event that the bookmarklet created on Resident Advisor as the `raEvent` of the session of the token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, only while it has none, as the token's admin

raEvent.description: The event's id on RA, or a link to it

get.summary: Parking Radio's public events, which are its announced sessions, upcoming and past: every upcoming one and the 20 most recent past ones, or every one that starts in a time range when one is given

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only the events that start at or after this date and time, in Québec time, with the offset from UTC in effect then, e.g. "2026-11-09T00:00-05:00"

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only the events that start before this date and time, in Québec time, with the offset from UTC in effect then, e.g. "2026-11-16T00:00-05:00"

get.summary: One of the sizes of a flyer that an event has

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The flyer's name, as the URL of its size gives it

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size's name, as its URL gives it, e.g. `w320.v2.webp`

200.description: That size of the flyer, as WebP. Browsers are told not to guess another type (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`), and that anyone, shared caches included, can keep it for good, without checking with the server again (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`): its URL changes whenever what it serves does

get.summary: Every calendar feed that the studio's occupations and holds are read from, with its kind, in the order they were added

total.description: How many items the list has

post.summary: Adds a calendar feed of occupations or holds, once its link gives a calendar

link.description: Trimmed: an https or webcal link, without a user name or a password, of at most 2000 characters as the server keeps it: in https, without what comes after #, and with its characters that links can't have encoded

post.summary: Reads every calendar feed now, and gives every feed once each read is done or failed

total.description: How many items the list has

patch.summary: Changes a calendar feed's name, kind or link, once a new link gives a calendar

link.description: Trimmed: an https or webcal link, without a user name or a password, of at most 2000 characters as the server keeps it: in https, without what comes after #, and with its characters that links can't have encoded

delete.summary: Removes a calendar feed, and forgets what was read from it

get.summary: What takes the studio over the days from `from` to `to`, both included, in Québec: sessions and occupations, its available time, and the calendar feeds that occupations and holds are read from, with their status, and, whatever the days, the conflicts and the sessions outside protected time of the next 365 days, and the sessions without a date

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, in Québec, e.g. "2026-11-01"

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, in Québec, included, e.g. "2026-11-30": at most 400 days from `from`, both included

today.description: The day the conflicts, the sessions outside protected time and the available time are counted from: today, in Québec

feeds.description: Every feed, in the order they were added, with when each was last read, and why that failed

sessions.description: The sessions with a start that take some of the days, whatever their status, by start

occupations.description: The occupations that take some of the days, by start, then end

availability.description: The available time that takes some of the days, stretch by stretch, by start: the protected time of the next 365 days, from 00:00 today, that no session that isn't cancelled, nor occupation, takes

conflicts.description: The conflicts of the next 365 days, from today, whatever the days asked for

unprotectedSessions.description: The sessions outside protected time, of the next 365 days, from today, by start, whatever the days asked for

undatedSessions.description: The sessions without a start that aren't cancelled, the most recently added first, whatever the days asked for

get.summary: The token of the links of the admin's calendars, which they get the first time they ask for it

post.summary: Replaces the token of the links of the admin's calendars, which makes the previous links stop working

get.summary: The Discord bot the server reaches the chat through, and its channel

put.summary: Entering the Discord bot's token and the channel it reaches

botToken.description: The bot's token, only letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Trimmed, then between 1 and 200 characters

channelId.description: The channel's id on Discord, trimmed: up to 20 digits

post.summary: Whether a bot's token and a channel pass the check with Discord, without saving them

botToken.description: The bot's token, only letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Trimmed, then between 1 and 200 characters

channelId.description: The channel's id on Discord, trimmed: up to 20 digits

get.summary: Every feature flag, and whether it is on

total.description: How many items the list has

put.summary: Turns a feature flag on or off

get.summary: What allowing an app would grant

post.summary: Allows an app, which gets a code, or refuses

get.summary: The logged-in admin's connected apps

total.description: How many items the list has

delete.summary: Disconnects one of the logged-in admin's apps
